{{Quote|Well, Senator Vericks has a full calendar today. But I can get you ten minutes between his finance subcommittee hearing and a working lunch.|Vericks' secretary|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Vericks''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Senator/Legends|senator]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] who replaced [[Vanara Kayl]] as senator of the [[Coruscant sector/Legends|Coruscant sector]] following the exposure of her dealings with the [[Migrant Merchants' Guild]] in [[3643 BBY]]. By that time, he was on a financial subcommittee, and had a full schedule most days.

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Thought I'd better come in person, see. This thing I read on the HoloNet says anyone can talk to their Senator.|A petitioner|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic" />}}
Vericks is only briefly mentioned in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', in an ambient conversation in the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. A [[Coruscanti/Legends|Coruscanti]] petitioner from the [[Old Galactic Market]] refers to Vericks as "their" Senator, meaning that Vericks is the Senator of Coruscant. Since Senator Kayl served since the [[Sacking of Coruscant]] in [[3653 BBY]], and the light side storyline of the mission involving Kayl results in her resignation, it is assumed that Vericks is Kayl's successor.
